summary: rec.gov 232656: confirmed $25 (2026 and 2027), 50 A + water on all 77 overnight sites (facility text says 71), 2 pull-throughs; added showers/flush/water/dump, season 04-01..10-31, 14-night max, 3-night holiday minimum. --AWH lakefront CONFIRMED on imagery (east tip and north-shore pads with open bank to the water). Note unchanged. Phone missing.
flags: WATERFRONT (--AWH value 'lakefront'): CONFIRMED, no ask needed. Leaf-off imagery with rec.gov's site points shows pads with open, road-free ground to the shoreline: the east-tip sites 19-24 (spurs pointing toward the water, ~20-35 m of open wooded bank to the waterline, loop road inland of them), north-shore 28-32 (pads between the loop road and a ~25-35 m open rocky bank) and 72-74 at the west end (~20-40 m open bank to the beach). Interior sites (35-60 etc.) are inland. rec.gov: 'Many campsites are adjacent to the waters edge'.
PHONE missing: the entry has none; recreation.gov's facility phone is 417-779-5376. apply.py does not write phone - add by hand.
Operator: USACE Little Rock District (Table Rock Lake), not commercially managed; federal stands. Website stays the rec.gov campground page.

Sites: the facility description says '71 reservable campsites' but the catalog has 77 overnight STANDARD ELECTRIC sites (all reservable) plus a group shelter; count written as 77. Every site fits EKKO: max vehicle lengths 34-66 ft, driveways 38-99 ft. max_rig_ft left unset.
Season: no statement; written from the rate season and the calendar (open nights 2026-10-31 and 2027-04-01, none in November or March). Other years' rate seasons end 10-30.
Pin 36.5594,-93.3194 (rec.gov's facility point) is ~175 m WSW of the 77-site centroid (36.56034,-93.31782), at the entrance end of the peninsula. Under 250 m; no move.
DISCOUNTS: rec.gov carries a 'militaryDiscount' rule value; not a discount claim, nothing written. Sewer: no sewer attribute on any site; left unset.
